paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles from a combined analysis of three flaring $\textit{Fermi}$ flat-spectrum radio quasars
notes: Astrophysical ALP-photon mixing search in blazar jets. Exclusion stated: 5 neV <~ m_a <~ 200 neV, g_agamma >~ 5e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL. Data points are approximate from text only; the actual exclusion contours are in figures not numerically given. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. | Vision: Boundary traced from the white exclusion contour in the upper panel of image 8 (combined analysis). Region above the contour is excluded. Y-axis from 1e-12 to 1e-10; x-axis mass from 5 neV to ~5000 neV. Minimum coupling ~4.6e-12 around m_a ~ 15-17 neV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
